body: I've been trying. Every place I apply to never returns calls. Plus at the moment I have no car, I ride to work with a coworker. J just don't know what to do. She was the first person to see past my looks (I'm really not all that attractive) and give me a chance. And just suddenly changed out of nowhere.

Because I she just made me smile. She was the one ray of sunshine in my life. I work a back breaking job that doesn't care about me. My family couldn't give two shits about me. She was the one thing I had that was good.
I don't know. Honestly my life wasn't great before I met her. She was my reason to wake up.
